name: mcp_tool_safe_numeric
notes: Numeric config coercion (mcp_tool.c::mcp_tool_safe_numeric vs LIVE tools/mcp_tool.py::_safe_numeric). Input tokens are <value|NULL>\t<default>; NULL encodes a null pointer. DOCUMENTED AGREEMENT-REGION RESTRICTION: the C port drops LIVE's coerce/minimum parameters entirely — strtod accepts floats ('3.7'->3.7), hex ('0x10'->16) and trailing garbage ('12abc'->12) where LIVE int() falls back to default, and LIVE clamps results below minimum=1 while C does not. The gate exercises only inputs where both sides agree: integer strings with int()-parseable forms >= 1, plus null/empty/unparseable defaults. Float/hex/garbage-suffix/sub-minimum inputs are known divergences worth a follow-up port fix.
